medicare_card_type.title: Card Type
medicare_card_type.description: regular | interim card | reciprocal health care

medicare_card_number.title: Card Number
medicare_card_number.description: 10-digit card number as shown on the front of the Medicare card e.g. 1234 56789 1

cardholders.title: Cardholders
cardholders.description: 1 to 5 cardholders listed on the card

position.title: Position
position.description: Single digit position number shown to the left of the name on the Medicare card (e.g. 1)

first_name.title: First Name
first_name.description: First name/Given name as shown on the name line of the Medicare card

middle_initial.title: Middle Initial
middle_initial.description: Middle name or initial as shown on the name line of the Medicare card (may appear as a single initial e.g. A)

last_name.title: Last Name
last_name.description: Last name/Family name/Surname as shown on the name line of the Medicare card

full_name.title: Full Name
full_name.description: Full name as shown on the name line of the Medicare card, position + first name + middle initial + last name (e.g. 1 JOHN A SMITH)

medicare_card_expiry_date.title: Expiry Date
medicare_card_expiry_date.description: Expiry month and year as shown on the Medicare card (MM/YYYY or DD/MM/YYYY)

secondary_document_front.title: Document Front Photo
secondary_document_front.description: Photo of the front of the Medicare card

secondary_document_back.title: Document Back Photo
secondary_document_back.description: Photo of the back of the Medicare card
